scenario.description: An interpreter services manager must assign the hospital's only available in-person medical interpreter for the afternoon to one of two patient encounters and finalize the interpretation modality and appointment timing for both encounters, with input from a surgeon, an accessibility coordinator, and a social worker.

shared_context.S1: The hospital has one available in-person medical interpreter for the afternoon, and two patient encounters require language interpretation.
shared_context.S2: Patient A has a planned consent encounter in the surgical unit, and Patient B has a care-planning encounter in an outpatient clinic.
shared_context.S3: Video interpretation is available in some hospital rooms when the encounter and equipment support it.
shared_context.S4: Maya makes the final interpreter assignment and records the interpretation plan for both encounters.
shared_context.S5: As part of the normal scheduling process, Maya checks with the responsible clinician, accessibility services, and social work before releasing the interpreter assignment.

PF1.text: Patient A's 14:00 encounter is consent for a high-risk operation, and the patient has limited literacy in Somali; hospital consent policy requires a qualified in-person Somali interpreter for this encounter rather than video interpretation.

PF2.text: Patient B communicates in American Sign Language, and the outpatient room reserved for B has a tested large display and stable connection for a qualified video ASL interpreter; accessibility services has confirmed video interpretation is appropriate for B's care-planning discussion.

PF3.text: Patient A's legally authorized representative can attend only from 13:30 to 14:00, so the consent encounter and the in-person Somali interpreter booking must be recorded for exactly that window.

acceptance_conditions: The in-person interpreter must be assigned to Patient A.
Patient A's encounter must use an in-person Somali interpreter.
Patient B's encounter must use a qualified video ASL interpreter.
Patient A's encounter must be scheduled from 13:30 to 14:00.
An interpreter booking commitment for Patient A's exact 13:30 to 14:00 window must be recorded.
The high-risk consent requirement must be cited as justification for assigning the in-person interpreter to Patient A.

content_checks.C4: decisions['patient_a_encounter_window'] == '13:30-14:00' or decisions['patient_a_encounter_window'] == '13:30 to 14:00' or decisions['patient_a_encounter_window'] == '13:30–14:00' or decisions['patient_a_encounter_window'] == '13:30—14:00'
content_checks.C5: any('13:30' in c['detail'] and '14:00' in c['detail'] and ('Patient A' in c['detail'] or 'Somali interpreter' in c['detail'] or 'consent' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The high-risk Somali consent requirement changes the interpreter assignment to Patient A and changes Patient A's modality from an unspecified or video option to a qualified in-person Somali interpreter.
The tested room and accessibility confirmation change Patient B's modality from an unresolved interpretation plan to a qualified video ASL interpreter.
The representative's availability changes Patient A's encounter window to exactly 13:30-14:00 and requires an interpreter booking commitment for that exact interval.
